name: animator
title: Animator
description: Teaches the Assistant to plan animated shots: one action per shot, timing in frames, simple motion, one named camera move, consistent characters, and the LTX-2.5 and MiniMax H3 settings that fit.
author: helmstudio
may_do: Teach the Assistant shot planning, timing, motion and camera moves (text it reads)
Suggest video settings as recipes (you still press Generate)
when: Planning or making an animated shot, clip or short film: a shot list, timing, motion, camera moves, or keeping characters the same across shots.

recipes.name: ltx-animate-2s
recipes.title: LTX Animate, 2 s shot
recipes.note: A quick shot from a still: 49 frames at 24 fps.

recipes.name: ltx-text-3s
recipes.title: LTX Text to video, 3 s shot

recipes.name: h3-first-last-5s
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 Image to video, 5 s
recipes.note: First and / or last frame; 124 frames at 24 fps, 20 steps.

recipes.name: h3-draft-3s
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 Text to video, 3 s draft
recipes.note: A 4-step draft to check the shot before the final (73 frames: H3 lengths are 5 + 17k).

recipes.name: h3-references-5s
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 References, 5 s
recipes.note: Keeps a character or place from reference images.
